ItemStage.description:
The pipeline's stage vocabulary - one name per step an item passes through.

**Three contracts take this type and only one of them means "terminal".**
`ItemHealthRow.stage` is the census column and records where an item
STOPPED, so it takes `TERMINAL_STAGES` and refuses anything else.
`DayStageTiming.stage` names the step a clock was read at, and
`telemetry.event(src=...)` names the step that logged a line. Neither of
those two is an ending, and neither is exhaustive - `publish_day_metrics`
times three of these names and one emitter writes one of them.

Declaration order is the funnel a person reads down, and
`retention.compact_month` sorts a month's groups by it. The order is free to
change: this is a `StrEnum`, so the wire value is the string and never the
position.
ItemStage.title: ItemStage

changelog.why: The enum is inlined here, so a name the event envelope gained moves this file.

changelog.change: Initial shape: one row per (date, stage) folded from an item-health shard.
changelog.why: The item-health census grows with every published day and nothing folded it.

description: One `(date, stage)` pair, summarised from one month of item-health rows.

failed.description: Of those rows, the ones whose outcome was not ok. The numerator.
failed.title: Failed

items.description: Rows the shard held for this date and stage, counted as they were written. A run that executed twice under one run id really does leave two rows for one item, and the fold reproduces that rather than deciding for a later reader which of them to believe.
items.title: Items

max_ms.description: The slowest row of the group.
max_ms.title: Max Ms

p50_ms.description: Nearest-rank median of fetch, extract and summarize milliseconds added up per row. Empty when no row at this stage recorded any - empty is not zero.
p50_ms.title: P50 Ms

sum_ms.description: Every timed row added together, so a day's total stage time survives the fold. A percentile cannot be re-added into a total; this can.
sum_ms.title: Sum Ms

timed.description: Of those rows, the ones that recorded any milliseconds at all. The denominator the four figures below are taken over, which is never the row count: a plan-stage row times nothing, and a row written before the timing columns existed times nothing either.
timed.title: Timed
